success.description: As above and the winds are unusually fierce; add affected characters must roll 1 {Dm} on all physical actions.

boon.description: Penalties imposed by the storm are reduced by your engagement.

bane.description: All physical actions suffer at least 1 {Dm}, and possibly more at GM discretion, and the storm plays havoc with sailing vessels and other watercraft, whose pilots must make Hard (3 {Dc}) checks of the relevant skills to avoid mishap.

sigmarsComet.description: All physical checks in the storm gain 1 {Dm}. You fall, or are blown or swept overboard.

reckless.requirements: 12 favour, must be under the open sky Effect While this blessing is recharging, a fierce storm breaks out within long range, churning the sea to angry waves and whipping rain and sea-foam through the air.
reckless.name: Living Storm
